summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for three new/changed features: (A) Exit-intent enquiry popup, (B) Awards & Honours section on About page, (C) Logo plaque inner color change. All features tested and verified working correctly.
passed_tests: Entry popup regression: Auto-popup appears after ~3s with all functionality intact (fillable inputs, working Select dropdowns that don't close popup, successful form submission)

Exit popup: Appears correctly after 8+ seconds when exit intent triggered (mouseout to top), shows correct heading 'Don't Miss Priority Allotment' and kicker 'Before You Go', dismiss text 'No thanks', form fully functional
Exit popup suppression: Correctly does NOT appear when homeland_lead_submitted flag is set, properly checks sessionStorage on component mount
Exit popup session control: Appears only once per session using homeland_exit_popup_shown flag
Awards section: Present on About page with all required awards (Emerging Tricity Award, Build X Punjab Award, 360 Real Estate Award) with year 2023
Logo plaque inner color: Changed from white to transparent grey rgba(69,69,69,0.4) on both project detail pages and upcoming page, verified via computed styles
